aboutGame.title: What is Dreadmoor?
paragraphs: Dreadmoor is a dark fantasy survival adventure game on Steam. Players explore a haunted world, fish for rare catches, scavenge resources, craft gear, and upgrade their boat to survive longer expeditions.
Whether you are learning the core gameplay loop, planning a crafting route, or hunting dangerous creatures, our wiki covers every system with guides, data tables, and step-by-step walkthroughs.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Dreadmoor.

items.question: What is Dreadmoor?
items.answer: Dreadmoor is a dark fantasy survival adventure game on Steam. You explore a haunted world, fish, scavenge resources, craft gear, and upgrade your boat to survive longer expeditions.

items.question: What platforms is Dreadmoor on?
items.answer: Dreadmoor is available on PC via Steam.

items.question: Is there a Dreadmoor demo?
items.answer: Yes, a free demo is available on Steam alongside the full game, which you can wishlist.

items.question: Where do I find active codes?
items.answer: Use the Codes page for working codes, rewards, expiration notes, and redeem instructions.

items.question: Are the guides updated?
items.answer: Guide pages are organized with walkthroughs, crafting data, creature notes, drops, and next steps for progression.

bosses.overviewDescription: Complete guides for every dangerous encounter in Dreadmoor, from aquatic threats to dark fantasy monsters.
bosses.body: Creatures in Dreadmoor serve as survival challenges and progression gates. Some encounters teach core combat fundamentals early on, while others guard rare resources, new regions, and valuable loot. Each creature has distinct attack patterns and telegraphed moves you need to learn. Use the guides below to prepare for every fight and expedition.
